strongest_angle: Examine the philosophical contributions of Martha Nussbaum following her September 2026 selection for the prestigious John W. Kluge Prize by the Library of Congress.

key_facts.fact: The Library of Congress announced on September 22, 2026, that Professor Martha C. Nussbaum is the recipient of the 2026 John W. Kluge Prize for Achievement in the Study of Humanity.
The John W. Kluge Prize is awarded every other year by the Library of Congress to recognize work that advances the understanding of the human experience.
Martha C. Nussbaum received her Bachelor of Arts from New York University and her Master of Arts and Doctor of Philosophy from Harvard University.
